scope: Full news/event sharing with quiet App Store footer

implementation.news: Full localized title, summary and body; repeated lead omitted; official source retained; no 400-character truncation
implementation.events: Full available description; all occurrences, venue/address, location note, organizer, pricing/currency/note, participation and cancellation
implementation.transport: Single plain-text UIActivityItemSource with subject/title metadata, presented in native UIActivityViewController. ShareLink custom preview lost Copy on iOS 27; replaced and regression tested.

footer.destination: App Store, not a specific material; universal content links are not configured

verification.model: 6 ContentShareTextTests passed, including native item representations for Copy/Mail/Messages and title metadata. EventSchedulePresentationTests regression passed.
verification.ui: Final native activity controller: four simulator share/copy/return scenarios passed (news/event, uk/light and de/dark), with title preview. Real copied payloads captured separately; no messages sent.
verification.storeLink: Generic countryless URL returned 404; Austria-specific URL returned 200 and Apple lookup confirmed UAC 1.3. Also opened the actual page in Safari.
verification.releasePreflight: Actual deployed analytics handlers: ACTIVE, no missing contracts
verification.physicalDevice: Not run; no actual message was sent to recipients
